name: nvar
title: Number of variables in an MCMC object

origin.description: The number of variables stored in an mcmc or mcmc.list object.
origin.details: A matrix chain returns its column count. A vector chain returns 1. An mcmc.list returns the column count of the first chain. Any other object returns NULL.
origin.value: A numeric vector of length 1, or NULL.
origin.example: n <- 2000; i <- seq_len(n); x <- cbind(sin(i/3)+0.2*cos(i), cos(i/5)+0.01*i, rep(2, n)); y <- cbind(sin(i/4)+0.15*cos(i/2), cos(i/6)+0.005*i, rep(1, n)); v <- sin(i/7); vals <- list(nvar(mcmc(x)), nvar(mcmc(v)), nvar(mcmc.list(mcmc(x), mcmc(y))), nvar(1)); cat(paste(vapply(vals, function(v) if (is.null(v)) "NULL" else sprintf("%.17g", v), character(1)), collapse=" "), "\n")

translation.description: The number of variables stored in an Mcmc or McmcList object.
translation.details: A matrix chain returns its column count. A vector chain returns 1. An McmcList returns the column count of the first chain. Any other object returns None.
translation.example: n = 2000; i = np.arange(1, n + 1, dtype=float); x = np.column_stack((np.sin(i / 3) + 0.2 * np.cos(i), np.cos(i / 5) + 0.01 * i, np.full(n, 2.0))); y = np.column_stack((np.sin(i / 4) + 0.15 * np.cos(i / 2), np.cos(i / 6) + 0.005 * i, np.full(n, 1.0))); v = np.sin(i / 7); vals = [nvar(as_mcmc(x)), nvar(as_mcmc(v)), nvar(as_mcmc_list([as_mcmc(x), as_mcmc(y)])), nvar(1)]; print(" ".join("NULL" if v is None else format(float(v), ".17g") for v in vals))
